spec.name: A
spec.query: 100 * process_resident_memory_bytes{k8s_namespace_name="<NAMESPACE>"} / on(namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) ( kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} )

annotations.resolution: kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} top pod {{ $labels.pod }}; check memory trend in SigNoz; if legitimate load, raise the container memory limit; if a leak, restart is a stopgap only — chase the leak.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} ({{ $labels.job }}) using {{ $value | printf "%.0f" }}% of its container memory limit for 15m+
